item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President assigns the Secretary a personal approval role and limits the pilot's organizational deployment; this is internal executive supervision of a discretionary program, not a present change in legal rights or a command to impose a specified later legal consequence.","evidence":"you must personally approve the creation and implementation of any pilot program"},{"segment_id":"2","code":2,"rationale":"The President requires the Secretary to make a specified opt-out right a term of any later-administered pilot program, dictating the legal consequence the agency must provide to participating complainants.","evidence":"the pilot programs provide that complaining parties may opt out of participation in the pilot programs at any time"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs the Secretary to report an assessment and supporting data to the EEOC after the pilot period; this is an internal reporting requirement, while the remaining sentence merely explains the directive's purpose.","evidence":"submit an assessment of the pilot programs, together with the relevant underlying data, to the EEOC"}]}
